title: Common errors explained
markdown:
> [!tip] Golden rule
> Fix the **first** error, rebuild, repeat. Later errors are often side-effects of the first.

## Compiler errors
| Message (GCC / MSVC wording varies) | Usually means | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `expected ';' before ...` | missing semicolon on the **previous** line | add `;` |
| `'x' was not declared in this scope` / `undeclared identifier` | typo, missing `#include`, wrong scope, used before declared | check spelling/scope; add header or forward declaration |
| `'cout' is not a member of 'std'` | missing `#include <iostream>` | include the header |
| `no matching function for call to ...` | wrong argument types/count | read the "candidates" list below it |
| `call of overloaded 'f(...)' is ambiguous` | two overloads equally good | cast an argument or add an exact overload ([[4.01 Overloading and Default Arguments]]) |
| `narrowing conversion of ... from 'double' to 'int'` | brace-init lost precision | use `static_cast` ([[2.05 Type Conversion and static_cast]]) |
| `assignment of read-only variable` | modifying a `const` | remove const or don't modify |
| `passing 'const X' as 'this' argument discards qualifiers` | calling a non-const member function on a const object | mark the member function `const` ([[6.04 this and const Member Functions]]) |
| `cannot bind non-const lvalue reference ... to an rvalue` | passing a temporary to `T&` | take `const T&` or `T&&` |
| `use of deleted function` | copying a non-copyable type (`unique_ptr`, `jthread`, stream) | `std::move` it or pass by reference |
| `invalid use of incomplete type` | only forward-declared where full definition needed | `#include` the header ([[6.06 Class Files and Nested Types]]) |
| `cannot declare variable 'x' to be of abstract type` | a pure virtual function isn't overridden | implement it ([[8.05 Abstract Classes and Interfaces]]) |
| `'override' ... does not override` | signature mismatch (const? param type?) | match the base exactly |
| `jump to case label crosses initialization` | variable defined inside a `case` | wrap the case body in `{ }` ([[3.02 switch]]) |
| `template argument deduction/substitution failed` | T couldn't be deduced / conflicting | specify `f<double>(...)` ([[4.02 Function Templates]]) |
| `constraints not satisfied` | type doesn't meet a concept | read which requirement failed ([[9.04 Concepts]]) |
| `redefinition of ...` | defined twice (missing header guard, definition in header) | `#pragma once`; move definitions to .cpp ([[1.08 Multiple Files and Headers]]) |

## Linker errors
| Message | Means | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `undefined reference to 'foo()'` / `LNK2019 unresolved external symbol` | declared but never defined, or the `.cpp` isn't compiled/linked | add the definition / add file to build / link the library |
| `multiple definition of 'x'` / `LNK2005 already defined` | a non-inline definition in a header included by several `.cpp`s | `inline`, or move to a `.cpp` ([[3.06 Global Variables and Linkage]]) |
| `undefined reference to 'main'` / `LNK1561 entry point must be defined` | no `main` or misspelled | write `int main()` |
| `undefined reference to vtable for X` | a virtual function declared but not defined | define all virtuals (often the destructor) |
| `cannot open file 'xyz.lib'` | library path wrong | fix library directories ([[10.09 CMake and Libraries]]) |

## Runtime crashes
| Symptom | Likely cause | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| Segmentation fault / Access violation reading 0x00000000 | null pointer dereference | [[4.04 Pointers]] |
| Access violation at random address | dangling pointer, out-of-bounds, use-after-free | [[7.02 new and delete]] |
| `vector subscript out of range` (MSVC debug) | bad index | [[5.01 Vectors]] |
| `std::out_of_range` / `terminate called after throwing` | uncaught exception | [[9.05 Exceptions]] |
| Stack overflow | infinite/deep recursion, huge local arrays | [[5.09 Recursion]] · [[7.01 Stack vs Heap]] |
| `double free or corruption` / heap corruption | deleting twice, shallow copy of owning pointer | [[7.03 Copy Semantics]] |
| Program hangs | infinite loop, deadlock | [[3.03 Loops]] · [[12.02 Mutexes and Locks]] |
| Garbage numbers | uninitialized variable | [[1.04 Variables and Initialization]] |
| Works in Debug, breaks in Release | undefined behavior | [[13.01 Undefined Behavior and Object Lifetime]] |
| Input loop goes crazy after typing letters | `cin` fail state not cleared | [[3.07 Input Validation and assert]] |

## Logic bugs that compile fine
- `if (x = 5)` instead of `==`
- `5 / 2` is `2` (integer division)
- `for (...);` or `if (...);` stray semicolon
- off-by-one: `i <= v.size()`
- `unsigned` counting down past 0
- comparing floats with `==`
- forgetting `break` in `switch`
- `std::string_view` / reference to a temporary that died
- object slicing when storing derived objects by value ([[8.06 Slicing, Casting and Composition]])
- missing `virtual` destructor in a polymorphic base

> [!info] Turn on `-Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -Wshadow` (or `/W4`) and the sanitizers — they catch most of these automatically. See [[13.09 Testing, Sanitizers and Static Analysis]].
